items.difficulty_reason: The proposition characterizes compact objects of D(A, d) as direct summands of modules with a finite filtration whose graded pieces are finite sums of shifts of A (statement lines 6502-6513). The proof (lines 6515-6561) runs a genuine compactness argument: the boundary of the filtration triangle is forced to vanish through the difference-map structure and the vanishing composition, compactness is used twice to obtain and then truncate the factorization, and the converse threads property (P), the Hom identifications and the triangulated structure down to the shift case. H2: the doubling-trick structure and the two compactness uses are the content, and no step is a bare citation.
